target: Inherited DataHub visual LSD skin-lesion grade; not clinical severity or stage
split: 60/20/20 stratified by duplicate-similarity group before training augmentation
duplicate_rule: Exact RGB or reflected pHash <= 6 and dHash <= 8, plus same-source links reviewed before training; exclude cross-label components
content_review: Before model training: assistant visual review of all 1019 thumbnails; exclude obvious illustrations, toys/statues, microscopy/product images, multi-panel figures, screenshots and large instructional/news graphics. Keep inherited photograph labels, including uncertain cases; no veterinary relabeling. Record decisions in content_review.json. Watermarked photographs remain a documented source-bias limitation.
independence_limit: No animal/farm identifiers are supplied; this is an image-group held-out experiment
encoder: torchvision MobileNet V3 Small, ImageNet1K V1 (047dcff4)
geometry: Pad full RGB image to square with (114,114,114), resize 224x224; no random crops
training_augmentation: Horizontal flip p=0.5; brightness/contrast +/- 10%; training partition only
reference_baselines: Balanced multinomial logistic regression on frozen encoder features, C=1
finetune_scope: Start from best validation head checkpoint; last four feature blocks and classifier; frozen blocks keep eval-mode BatchNorm
training_loss: Class-weighted cross entropy, inverse frequency from training partition only
early_stopping: Fine tuning patience 5; validation macro F1 with validation NLL tie-break
selection: Choose linear probe or best neural checkpoint by validation macro F1, validation NLL tie-break
calibration: One scalar temperature fitted to validation NLL after model selection; range 0.25 to 10
test_policy: Evaluate only after model and temperature are frozen; do not select on test metrics
uncertainty: 1000 stratified image-group bootstrap replicates; not clinical confidence intervals
deployment: Research CLI only; existing clinical/veterinary workflow unchanged
